fields.climate: principally desert; northeast monsoon (December to February), moderate temperatures in north and hot in south…
fields.terrain: mostly flat to undulating plateau rising to hills in north
fields.hazards: recurring droughts; frequent dust storms over eastern plains in summer; floods during rainy season
fields.resources: uranium and largely unexploited reserves of iron ore, tin, gypsum, bauxite, copper, salt, natural gas, likely oil reserves
fields.farm: camel milk, milk, goat milk, sheep milk, sugarcane, fruits, sorghum, cassava, vegetables, maize
fields.exports: sheep and goats, gold, postage stamps/documents, other animals, cattle
fields.industries: light industries, including sugar refining, textiles, wireless communication
fields.religions: Muslim 99.9% (Sunni Muslim 98.1%, Shia Muslim 1.2%, Islamic schismatic 0.6%), ethnic religionist 0.1%

independence.from: a merger of British Somaliland, which became independent from the UK on 26 June 1960, and Italian Somaliland, which became independent from the Italian-administered UN trusteeship on 1 July 1960 to form the Somali Republic

fields.legal: mixed system of civil law, Islamic (sharia) law, and customary law (referred to as Xeer)
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal suffrage starting with 24 June 2024 local elections
fields.military: 18-22 for voluntary military service for men and women in the Somali Armed Forces; compulsory service is reportedly authorized, but not currently utilized
